title: Durable governed branch hygiene and auditable cleanup

phases.objective: Evaluate branch inventory through the governed policy and produce exact-head, non-secret JSON, CSV, and Markdown triage reports while refusing unsafe deletion categories.

e2e_journeys.actor: scheduled Branch Hygiene workflow or repository maintainer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Branch Hygiene workflow invoking the registered maintenance tool
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A bounded report classifies merged, unmerged, open-PR, protected, excluded, and recent branches; only eligible merged branches can enter the apply path.
steps: Load the centralized Branch Hygiene policy and bind its SHA-256 into the report.
Evaluate a representative branch inventory against the exact main SHA and open-PR/protection context.
Classify old unmerged, open-PR, protected, Spec 015, Promotion/recovery, recent, and merged eligible branches.
Emit the canonical v2 JSON report with safety flags and zero deletion in dry-run mode.
Render deterministic CSV and Markdown triage views from the same sorted branch inventory.
Require the exact APPLY_BRANCH_HYGIENE confirmation before any apply mode is permitted.
assertions: An old merged branch with no open PR can be classified delete_eligible.
An old unmerged branch is report-only and never delete_eligible.
Open-PR, protected, Spec 015, Promotion, recovery, and evidence branches are never delete_eligible.
A recent merged branch remains inside the grace period.
The report binds the policy SHA and exact main SHA and declares all external mutation safety flags false except the bounded branch deletion capability.
Each branch exposes priority, reasonCode, recommendedAction, actionOwner, ageBand, namespace, and a deterministic triage position.
The CSV is sortable and the Markdown view contains priority/action summaries plus a bounded actionable queue.
The policy tests execute without database, provider, Production, migration, grant, or credential access.

phases.objective: Observe weekly reports and tune only documented false positives without weakening fail-closed deletion predicates.
Add bounded recovery and archived review evidence for stale unmerged branches without automatic work loss.
Observe scheduled hygiene on a non-production branch inventory before extending cleanup scope.
Keep Production protected and require explicit governance before any expansion beyond merged branch cleanup.
